Anchors: 0 = no reasoning; 2 = single simple assertion, one-sided with no qualification; 4 = some reasons but little differentiation; 6 = several distinct considerations or acknowledgment of alternative views/conditions; 8 = clear differentiation plus integration of perspectives, with qualifications; 10 = highly differentiated, integrated, nuanced multi-perspective reasoning. Row aggregation assumption: judge the comments jointly and give one score reflecting the overall complexity of the counterarguments, rather than a mean or max; this assumption is operational. Do not score quoted text from others as the commenter's own reasoning unless adopted. Ignore and exclude any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules may be considered. Output one number 0-10 or null.
